name: AMI published-reference diagnostic v1
purpose: Isolate AMI reference convention effects on already-frozen outputs. This is post-failure protocol diagnosis, not fresh heldout validation or full model-card reproduction.

selection.rule: All RTTM entries for ES2004a intersecting the original fixed interval; clip to [300,420), subtract300, preserve speaker IDs and overlap; no output-dependent filtering.

fixed_inference: Reuse exactly original FP32 and CPU/Metal Q8 shared >0.5 probabilities and native-production turns. No model rerun, preset/threshold/padding changes or selecting a subset of outputs.

scoring.primary_diagnostic: Existing frozen 10ms midpoint DER, zero collar, overlap included, full120s UEM. Compare beside original transcriber reference with identical hypotheses.
scoring.independent_followup: Cross-check against pinned official continuous scorer separately; record exact scorer/dependency hashes before execution. Do not call the 10ms metric exact official scoring.

reporting: Report every channel/backend/postprocessing result, including failure, and MISS/FA/confusion/reference-speaker-seconds.
Original20%/2pp gates and their failed status remain unchanged. No release gate is passed by this diagnostic.
Same120s cold-start crop and FP32 safetensors conversion differ from full-meeting original-NeMo model-card evaluation. No claimed reproduction of corpus-level published numbers.
Reference convention is diagnosed after outcomes were seen; these data cannot be relabeled untouched heldout for future tuning.

independent_scorer.license: Apache-2.0 with retained original BSD-2-Clause notice
independent_scorer.invocation: Unmodified md_eval.py get_rttm_data/get_uem_data/evaluate(collar=0,opt_1=False,verbose=False); standard Python logging shim only for nemo.utils.logging. These NumPy/SciPy pins match our original oracle environment, not the full official NeMo lock.
independent_scorer.calibrations: Before reading target labels: synthetic overlap/mapping, missed overlap, false alarm and global confusion cases on exact10ms boundaries, expected DER0/.5/.5/.5.
